title: Why Do Footprints on the Moon Last Millions of Years?
topic: Why the footprints on the Moon will last for millions of years
description: Discover how the Moon's lack of atmosphere, wind, and liquid water protects astronaut footprints from the rapid erosion seen on Earth. Learn why micro-meteorite impacts and solar radiation are the only slow forces that eventually alter lunar soil over millions of years. Subscribe and follow us for more.
